html:
G'oya

Avval qaysi karta qolishini aniqlaymiz, keyin qolganlarini o'chiramiz. Har bir pasport guruhida kartalarni "qolish navbati" bo'yicha tartiblaymiz: kitoblar soni kamayish bo'yicha, keyin ochilgan sana, keyin id. Birinchi o'rindagisi qoladi, ROW_NUMBER 1 dan katta bo'lganlar o'chadi.

Yechim

DELETE FROM members
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT id
  FROM (
    SELECT m.id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY UPPER(REPLACE(m.passport, ' ', ''))
             ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans l WHERE l.member_id = m.id) DESC, m.joined_on, m.id
           ) AS rn
    FROM members m
    WHERE m.passport IS NOT NULL
  ) t
  WHERE rn > 1
)

Kitoblar soni ORDER BY ichidagi korrelyatsiyalangan so'rov bilan hisoblanadi. WHERE m.passport IS NOT NULL pasportsiz kartalarni umuman tartiblashga kiritmaydi, shuning uchun ular o'chmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

PARTITION BY NULL larni bitta guruhga yig'adi. Pasportsiz kartalar chiqarib tashlanmasa, ikki xil Bekzod bitta odam bo'lib qoladi va biri o'chadi:

Noto'g'riDELETE FROM members
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT id
  FROM (
    SELECT m.id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY UPPER(REPLACE(m.passport, ' ', ''))
             ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans l WHERE l.member_id = m.id) DESC, m.joined_on, m.id
           ) AS rn
    FROM members m
  ) t
  WHERE rn > 1
)

Odatdagi "eng kichik id qoladi" qoidasi bu yerda ishlamaydi: kitobxon tarixi ko'p bo'lgan karta qolishi kerak, aks holda kitoblarni ko'chirish ishi ko'payadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Kitoblar sonini avval LEFT JOIN va GROUP BY bilan alohida CTE'da hisoblash mumkin. Natija bir xil, katta jadvalda esa bu tezroq: korrelyatsiyalangan so'rov har bir karta uchun alohida ishlaydi.

WITH c AS (
  SELECT m.id, UPPER(REPLACE(m.passport, ' ', '')) AS p, m.joined_on, COUNT(l.id) AS n
  FROM members m
  LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.member_id = m.id
  WHERE m.passport IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.id, m.passport, m.joined_on
),
r AS (
  SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY n DESC, joined_on, id) AS rn
  FROM c
)
DELETE FROM members
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM r WHERE rn > 1)
